info.name: Twilio Forge: Messaging Reimagined
info.description:
Follow-along Postman Collection for the requests sent as part of the Twilio Forge: Messaging Reimagined workshop at SIGNAL San Francisco 2026.

## Setup

- You will need an activated Twilio account.
    
- Create an [API Key from the Twilio Console](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/keys-in-console). Consider creating a Restricted key with only the service you need. You can alternately create an [API key using the REST API](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v1).
    
- Add the API Key and Secret to the environment.
    
- Get the Account SID from the Twilio Console homepage and add it to the environment.
    
- Follow the [Runbook's setup instructions](https://github.com/kaustavdm/forge-messaging-reimagined/blob/main/RUNBOOK.md) and create additional resources.
    

### Story

Owl Store detects that Twill is a VIP customer. An automated flow sends Twill a personalised sale alert, curated product recommendations, and delivery options — all via RCS.

request.description:
Send an RCS message with a message string in the `Body`.

Using a Messaging Service with an RCS Sender attached and SMS fallback configured, this request will send the simple text as RCS if the receiving phone supports RCS, otherwise it will be delivered as SMS.

item.name: Your First RCS Message - without fallback

urlencoded.description: Phone number prefixed with `rcs:` to disable SMS fallback

urlencoded.value: Hi from the Twilio Forge session on RCS! This time without SMS fallback.

request.description: Even while using a Messaging Service with SMS fallback configured, you can explicitly disable fallback by prefixing the phone number in the `To` field with `rcs:`.
